posts.name: Kulsoom Fatima
posts.cooked:
My query is that, Can I give BPT 1 in another system other than my own laptop. I am having some issues with my laptop and cannot acces it right now. Will it create problems during OPPE and other BPTs.
Regards
Kulsoom

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: It is totally fine, but make sure to submit BPT before deadline, that is what is important.

posts.name: Kulsoom Fatima
posts.cooked:
So no issues if i submit it from 2 different laptops ?? A senior told me i would not be able to access my BPT 1 and it won’t be calulated during OPPE and final scoring.
Regards
Kulsoom

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: As long as you login from your account and submit it on time it is fine Kulsoom.
